name: Ishikawa (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ishikawa town emblem in white: a ring with wing-like strokes and a pointed top.
history: Municipal flag of Ishikawa, a town in Fukushima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1966.

features.role: Ishikawa town emblem — a ring with wing-like strokes and a pointed top
